name: veilguard-backend
description: Veilguard scan service — API + queue + Cloud Run worker + Firestore. Wraps the veilguard-scanner engine.

scripts.dev:all: PATH="$PWD/.jre/bin:$PATH" ALLOW_PRIVATE_TARGETS=1 firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-veilguard "tsx functions/src/local-server.ts"
scripts.trigger: PATH="$PWD/.jre/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-veilguard "tsx scripts/trigger-scan.ts"
scripts.test: PATH="$PWD/.jre/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-veilguard "vitest run"
scripts.gate: PATH="$PWD/.jre/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-veilguard "tsx test/gate.ts"
